lines.zh: 我贴着沙底慢慢滑过去。
lines.en: I glide low and slow over the sand.

lines.zh: 沙粒从我的鳃缝里筛出去。
lines.en: Sand sifts out through my gill slits.
My barbels feel the way ahead.

lines.zh: 我绕开珊瑚，贴着凹地走。
lines.en: I round the coral and hug the hollow.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫一下，沙面就平了。
lines.en: One tail sweep smooths the sand.

lines.zh: 浅水的暖意落在我的背上。
lines.en: Warm shallows rest on my back.
I follow the shadow along the reef base.
I cover this stretch with little effort.

lines.zh: 脚下的沙里有蟹壳的响。
lines.en: Crab shells crunch beneath me.
No hurry; I drift over to that side.
My fin tips brush the seagrass.
I know every descending slope by heart.

lines.zh: 我贴着一块旧船板滑过去。
lines.en: I slide past a rotting hull plank.

lines.zh: 我把胸鳍撑在沙上歇一下。
lines.en: I prop my pectoral fin on the sand.

lines.zh: 我沿着沟底绕一圈，再回来。
lines.en: I circle the trench bottom and come back.

lines.zh: 前面沙里露出半只蟹，我慢下来。
lines.en: Half a crab shows in the sand ahead; I slow down.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁壁滑行，避开上面的光。
lines.en: I glide along the reef wall, out of the light above.

lines.zh: 海草扫过我的肚皮，有点痒。
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my belly and it tickles.

lines.zh: 我趴在沙上，一动也不动。
lines.en: I lie on the sand without moving.

lines.zh: 有东西在壳里动，我听着。
lines.en: Something stirs in a shell; I listen.
My barbels wave softly in the water.

lines.zh: 一口水从鳃里出去，沙起雾。
lines.en: One gillful out, and the sand fogs.
I do not chase; I wait for it to come.
Cool sand against my belly suits me.

lines.zh: 我在礁石缝里数着小鱼。
lines.en: I count the small fish in the crevice.
Something moves far off; I hold still.
My eyes pale in the dim water.

lines.zh: 潮水推我一下，我挪半寸。
lines.en: The tide nudges me half an inch.

lines.zh: 我把嘴凑向一个空贝壳。
lines.en: I press my mouth to an empty shell.

lines.zh: 沙跳进我嘴里，我吐出来。
lines.en: Sand got in my mouth; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，水里没有风。
lines.en: I blink slowly; there is no wind here.
I have held this trench a long while.

lines.zh: 你站在那，水都被你搅动。
lines.en: You stand there, stirring the water.
Your legs are more interesting than the reef.
I lift my eyes to you without rising.

lines.zh: 你在水面上喘气，我听得清。
lines.en: I hear you breathing up at the surface.
Whose is that meat in your hand?

lines.zh: 我绕着你转了半圈就停。
lines.en: I swim halfway around you and halt.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的沙上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my sand.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我记住了。
lines.en: I do not know you, but I remember you.
You stepped into my sand trench.
I watch you and sink a little lower.
It hurts; I flinched.
I remember the smell of whoever hit me.
The blow numbed my gills.
I kicked up a cloud of sand.
I make no sound; I sink deeper.
My hide split; blood clouds the water.

lines.zh: 这一下敲在我胸鳍的根上。
lines.en: That struck the root of my pectoral fin.
I turn and lash my tail out.
It hurts enough that I bite the sand.
Do not strike a second time.
Blood smell; I caught it first.
The smell of crab pulls me forward.
Drop the meat and I will come.
I open my mouth and suck a mouthful.
Stop waving it; it makes me hungry.
I rarely swim this fast.
I can crack that shell.
Step back; I am going to suck it in.
I smell snails, sweeter than meat.
One foot closer and I stop being polite.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的背，沙扬起来。
lines.en: You bumped my back and the sand rose.
My hide is thick; the blow made no sound.
Do not step on my tail; it whips.

lines.zh: 你把我从沙里推开半尺。
lines.en: You shoved me half a foot off the sand.
I brush past you; just passing through.
This patch is small; we both crowd it.
Your boot caught my gills.
I back off; the path is yours.
A knock underwater barely hurts.
Push again and I sink for deeper water.

lines.zh: 同类靠近时，我贴着沙转圈。
lines.en: When my kind near, I circle low over sand.
I touch it with my barbels; it does not flinch.
We lie side by side in the reef's shade.
It nips my fin, very gently.

lines.zh: 这一带的水够暖，可以留下。
lines.en: These waters are warm enough to stay.
We circled three times before parting.
Its hide is rougher than mine.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过去让它靠。
lines.en: I turn my flank so it can lean in.
The sandy floor is our nest.

lines.zh: 它摆尾走了，我还趴在沙上。
lines.en: It swam off; I stayed flat on the sand.

lines.zh: 我只有嘴，叼不起这铁片。
lines.en: Only a mouth; I cannot carry this iron.

lines.zh: 那块肉落进沙里，算我的。
lines.en: That meat landed in the sand; mine now.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推了推这个贝壳。
lines.en: I nudge the shell with my snout.
It is stuck in the reef; I cannot suck it free.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西沉到我脚边。
lines.en: What you dropped sank to my fins.

lines.zh: 铁片在水里发涩，我不吃。
lines.en: Iron tastes sour down here; I leave it.
I only take what I can crush.
A bucket drifted down; I swam around it.

lines.zh: 沙盖住了它，我找不到了。
lines.en: Sand covered it; I cannot find it.
I tried to carry it and dropped it.
There is blood in the water; I turn.

lines.zh: 那条鱼游得歪，我盯上了。
lines.en: That fish swims crooked; I have chosen it.
First I check whether it has a shell.

lines.zh: 它比我短一截，游得更笨。
lines.en: It is shorter than me and swims clumsier.
This one is worth rising for.
I draw my barbels in and press forward.
It fled; I remember which way.

lines.zh: 礁石后面有东西在拍水。
lines.en: Something is thrashing behind the reef.
I pick the one on the edge.
My belly complains; time to move.
I flatten low and creep over the sand.
It is busy sifting sand and has not seen me.
I swing around to its downstream side.
My tail barely moves at all.
A little closer and then I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 它掉头，我顺着沙沟跟过去。
lines.en: It turned; I follow along the sand trench.
A cloud of sand can hide my shape.
I count the beats of its tail.
This angle is the best for a bite.
I halt a foot behind it.
I suck it in, and the shell cracks.

lines.zh: 牙齿在里面碾，外面听不见。
lines.en: My teeth grind inside; nothing shows.

lines.zh: 它在嘴里挣两下就软了。
lines.en: It struggled twice inside my mouth and went limp.
The bite turned up a puff of sand.
I shake my head and spit the shell out.
Your leg is harder to bite than fish.
When done, I sink back onto the sand.
The blood spreads slowly in the water.
One bite is enough for me.
Do not reach in; I will test it.

lines.zh: 我从沙里醒过来，身上全是沙。
lines.en: I wake in the sand, covered in it.
This shallows has me for the first time.
The water is as warm as I remember.
I try a swing of my tail.

lines.zh: 礁影里有个空位，我占了。
lines.en: There is an empty spot in the reef shade; mine.
Light above; I look up at it.
Sand is still caught in my gills.
I smell crab, and I smell iron.

lines.zh: 我慢慢离开出生的凹坑。
lines.en: I leave the hollow where I began.
This stretch is mine to patrol.
Even underwater, fire burns my hide.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔下来，背先着沙。
lines.en: I fell from the surface, back first onto sand.
I am in water yet cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 炸开的水把我掀得打转。
lines.en: The blast threw me into a spin.
Something barbed is stuck in my back.
This chill has crawled into my gills.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连贝壳都想咬。
lines.en: My belly is empty; even shells look edible.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hit the water and shook all of me.

lines.zh: 这里连沙都没有，我怎么藏。
lines.en: There is not even sand here to hide in.
